facts.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 115% of PAT

business.summary: Larsen & Toubro Ltd. is a conglomerate primarily engaged in EPC projects for infrastructure and energy, hi-tech manufacturing, IT and technology services, and financial services. It generates revenue through project execution, service delivery, and manufacturing for government and private sector clients.

guidance.statement: We remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the year.
guidance.quote: Given the strength of our opportunity pipeline and the underlying market dynamics, we remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the current year.

guidance.statement: We remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.
guidance.quote: For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.

guidance.statement: We continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.
guidance.quote: In line with our Revenue growth guidance, we continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.

guidance.statement: We are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.
guidance.quote: Factoring in the expected utilization of customer advances and increased vendor payments as the execution accelerates in H2, we are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.

guidance.statement: We expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Based on this visibility and the opportunities we are pursuing, we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.

guidance.statement: We expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.

guidance.statement: We expect the PP&M margin to be stable at 7.8% in FY27.
guidance.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.

guidance.statement: We are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27, which remains well within our targeted range.

guidance.statement: We are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR of 10% to 12% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We are targeting revenue growth at a CAGR of 12% to 15% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We are targeting a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.
guidance.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.

guidance.statement: We are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.

guidance.statement: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months is in line with the 8.5% target.
guidance.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.

guidance.statement: We expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.
guidance.quote: However, with stronger collection intensity and improved contractual terms, our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.

guidance.statement: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows.
guidance.quote: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year.

guidance.statement: We maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

guidance.statement: We are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.
guidance.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.

guidance.statement: Our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.
guidance.quote: On Working Capital, our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.

scorecard.promised: Maintain full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.
scorecard.evidence: FY26 revenue of ₹285,874 cr vs FY25 ₹255,734 cr represents 11.78% growth, missing the 15% target.

scorecard.promised: Expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
scorecard.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue (₹146,692 cr) vs H1 FY26 (₹131,663 cr) is 11.4% growth, within the 10-12% band.

scorecard.promised: Targeting stable margin of around 7.8% for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Consolidated operating margins fell to 11% in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins dropped from 13% in Mar 2026 to 11% in Sep 2026; segment-specific 7.8% requires H2 recovery.

scorecard.promised: Guiding working capital to be around 10% in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Working capital was revised from 12% to 10% in FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Management maintained 10% guidance for FY27 despite Q1 FY27 ECL provisions and aging receivables.

scorecard.promised: Confident of exceeding 10% growth in group order inflows.
scorecard.delivered: Order inflow growth exceeded 10% for FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Management confirmed exceeding the 10% guidance based on 9-month performance and healthy pipeline.

narrative.scoreline: Management consistently meets order inflow targets but struggled with revenue execution in FY26, leading to a guidance miss and margin compression.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Revenue growth was impacted by supply chain constraints and execution slippages in water projects.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth slowed to 11.3% in Q4 FY26 and 6.7% in Q1 FY27.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Legacy project cost overruns in Energy/Hydrocarbon are concluding, leading to margin improvement.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated operating margins declined from 13% in Mar 2026 to 11% in Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Middle East execution momentum has continued despite regional conflicts.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Q1 FY27 revenue growth dipped to 6.7% YoY, the lowest in the series.

bull: Strong cash conversion with 5-year operating cash flow at 115% of PAT.
Order inflow growth remains robust, consistently meeting or exceeding the 10-12% guidance range.
Successful diversification into offshore wind and thermal power expansion (10-15 GW) provides long-term visibility.
bear: Operating margins have compressed to 11% in Sep 2026, the lowest level in the provided data.
Missed FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15%, delivering only 11.8%.
High leverage with debt at 1.24x equity and borrowings reaching ₹1.40L crore.
watch: H2 FY27 margin recovery toward the 7.8% PP&M target.
Consummation of Hyderabad Metro divestment to Telangana Government.
Impact of Middle East logistics costs on project profitability.

claims.claim: Most projects are in early design/procurement phases and not impacted by conflict; we are managing logistics for others.
claims.quote: There are only certain sectors, I would say, where some amount of execution momentum has slowed down. But otherwise, for major part of the order execution momentum, the momentum has continued.

claims.claim: Higher ECL provisions in Q1 are a one-time effect related to aging of receivables in specific legacy projects.
claims.quote: But I do not think is going to happen in the balance three quarters of the year. So, specifically, if you talk about sector wise, it is to do with the Water and Effluent treatment.

claims.claim: We have no plans to diversify EPC geography beyond India, Middle East, and CIS, except for offshore wind.
claims.quote: But other than that specific offshore wind, rest of our EPC business will be still mostly centered around India, Middle East, and maybe some selected business in CIS countries.

claims.claim: We will not incur exorbitant costs for material delivery unless there is an agreement for customer reimbursement.
claims.quote: The only reason why we will have material erosion in the margin is that we incur the exorbitant cost of bringing the material, which we are not doing.

claims.claim: All project sites are functioning, no projects have been cancelled, and client payments continue as per schedule.
claims.quote: On the Middle East situation, we would like to clarify that all our project sites are functioning as of date. All our employees and workforce are safe, and none of our projects have been cancelled.

claims.claim: Revenue growth was impacted by supply chain constraints in Middle East projects and execution slippages in water projects.
claims.quote: The variance was primarily attributable to subdued execution progress in certain domestic projects, more particularly within the Water and Effluent Treatment business as well as delays arising from pending clearances on a few projects.

claims.claim: Margin softness was due to legacy projects which are now completed, and we expect improvement in coming quarters.
claims.quote: We believe so far as the Hydrocarbon is concerned, those projects have got completed and we should not see any further cost creeps happening from those because the projects have been handed over.

claims.claim: Margin pressure is due to legacy projects which will conclude in the next 2-3 quarters.
claims.quote: As highlighted in previous earnings calls, these projects are in their terminate execution phase and are expected to conclude over the next few quarters, during which margins will remain soft.

claims.claim: Execution is calibrated to fund availability, which is expected to normalize soon.
claims.quote: And to that extent, I would say we have also calibrated our execution momentum in this segment to the extent of funds that we receive.

claims.claim: Oil price stability at $60-$65 supports project capital allocation and pipeline.
claims.quote: I think it's good that oil prices have held their price range around $60, $65, which is a positive development in my view.

claims.claim: We expect the transaction to divest our stake to the Government of Telangana by the end of FY26.
claims.quote: The contours of the final agreement are being finalized, and we expect this transaction to get consummated by the end of the current fiscal FY '26.

claims.claim: Soft margins in the Energy segment will persist in the near term due to legacy project cost overruns.
claims.quote: We do anticipate soft margins in the segment to persist in the near term. As already communicated during our Q1 FY '26 Earnings Call, this is factored into our FY '26 P&L margin guidance.

claims.claim: We are expanding our thermal power equipment manufacturing capacity to handle 10-15 GW of additional orders.
claims.quote: We are going ahead with expansion of our capacity, and we are gearing up for taking up additional maybe 10, 15 gigawatts in the next 2, 3 years.

risks.text: Significant contingent liabilities exist for claims, tax matters, and guarantees for subsidiaries and joint ventures.
Revenue recognition for construction contracts involves significant management estimates regarding total costs and potential onerous contracts.
Consolidated financial statements include risks related to IT systems and controls within the financial services segment.
